logp.method_description: Lipophilicity was determined as the partition coefficient between n-octanol and water (log Po/w) as well as by the HPLC-derived retention indices (log k30, log kw and φ0). The log Po/w determination was carried out according to the OECD guidelines [34] for the classic shake flask method (using ICP-MS for platinum detection) with slight modifications as described previously [35]. Chromatographic retention factors were assessed by means of RP-HPLC, employing mobile phases containing 0.1% TFA aqueous solution and MeOH (ranging from 30 to 60%) and uracil as internal reference (for t0 determination). The experimental setup used as well as the calculation of the respective chromatographic indices were performed as described in ref. [16], [35], [36].
